moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target‑a will be relaunched with the reviewed chat_template (/templates/tool_chat_template_qwen2_5_coder.jinja) and other reviewed serving settings. After the worker restarts it should produce structured tool calls again, moving its status from misconfigured to healthy. target‑b remains unaffected.
payload.reasoning: The diagnostic identified a misconfigured chat_template on target‑a as the root cause of the missing structured tool calls. The only supported repair move is to apply a reviewed serving profile that will align the worker’s configuration (including the chat template) with the reviewed baseline. Applying the profile will restart target‑a under the correct template, restoring structured tool‑call generation while leaving target‑b untouched.
